description: ACT Bike Barometer - MacArthur Avenue is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by ACT Government Open Data. This dataset contains the number of trips counted by the bike barometer located on the Sullivan's Creek shared path at the intersection with MacArthur Avenue in O'Connor. The data is recorded in hourly intervals, and is collected using an induction loop similar to systems used for traffic light monitoring. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher ACT Government Open Data. Its tags are active-travel, barometer, bicycle, bike. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
